c74object.name: evi_biquads_no_tilde
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_biquads_no_tilde.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_biquads_no_tilde.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
The first section of this file is identical to the 40 filter types available in 'evi_biquads_coeffs.genexpr', but with all coefficients calculators adjusted to accept audio samplerate as a parameter so that all of these coefficients calculators can be used at schedular rate in gen (no tilde) for huge efficiency savings when circumstances allow. @see the [evi.biquadcoeff] abstraction for the example of how this is done. The rest of this file is a repeat of 'evi_biquads_selectors', similarly adjusted for gen (no tilde) usage. All functions are named identically to their ~ equivelents, but have an additional 'AUDIO_SR' parameter so audio samplerate can be passed in.
